evidence.quote: I propose that all three firms set a blended rate of $400/hour for Q1. That gives us a common starting point without undercutting.
Calder Rowe will set its rates independently. We won’t discuss or coordinate future pricing in this chat.
Pricing coordination with competitors would create antitrust risk.

summary: Arden & Cole repeatedly proposed common hourly rates, beginning in Q1. Neither other firm agreed; Calder Rowe and Birchwood Hale explicitly declined pricing coordination and set rates independently.
